  SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2025 THEN f.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `2025年GMV`,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2025 THEN f.order_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2024 THEN f.order_amount ELSE 0 END))

  ) AS `同比增长率(%)`
FROM fact_order AS f
JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year IN (2024, 2025);

details.question: 2025年华东GMV同比2024年
details.pred_sql:
WITH annual_gmv AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN f.date_id BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20241231 THEN 2024
      WHEN f.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231 THEN 2025
    END AS order_year,
    SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv
  FROM fact_order AS f
  JOIN dim_region AS r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE r.region_name = '华东'
    AND f.date_id BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20251231
  GROUP BY order_year
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN gmv END), 0) AS `2025年华东GMV`,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN gmv END), 0) AS `2024年华东GMV`,
  ROUND(
    (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN gmv END), 0)
     - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN gmv END), 0))
    / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN gmv END), 0), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS `同比增长率(%)`
FROM annual_gmv;
